edge treatment
Explicit approved blank allowances are required
Complete carcass/back connections, residual walls and loads require engineered design
No verified connector/hardware schedule is supplied
Glass type, actual thickness, edges, retention and safety evidence required
Pane is visual only; retention and glass cut dimensions are not engineered
Hinge pivot, opening sweep and collision envelope are not verified
hinge configuration is missing
handle configuration is missing
glass_retainer configuration is missing
Projected review views are not complete section/joint/tolerance shop drawings
Strength, stability, glass safety and machining safety require qualified review and a real measured benchmark
No approved procurement, labour, finishing or packaging prices supplied
Solid, envelope, placement and intersection checks ran; these do not establish structural safety
